# Code of conduct

I want this project to be a good place for everyone, whatever their age, body, disability, ethnicity, gender, experience, nationality, looks, race, religion or sexual identity.

## What I expect

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new.
- Respect different opinions and ways of working.
- Give feedback on the code, not the person.
- When you get something wrong, say sorry and learn from it.

## What's not ok

- Insults, put-downs, or attacks on someone's identity.
- Sexual language or images, or unwanted attention.
- Harassing someone, in public or in private.
- Sharing someone's private info without their ok.
- Anything else a reasonable person would see as not ok in a professional place.

## Where this applies

In this repo (issues, PRs, comments, reviews) and anywhere you speak for the project.

## Reporting

If someone breaks these rules, email me at elhawarydev@gmail.com. I'll read every report, keep it private, and reply as soon as I can.

## What happens next

Depending on how serious it is, I may:

1. Send a private warning and ask the person to stop.
2. Remove comments, issues or PRs that break the rules.
3. Block the person from the project for a while.
4. Block them for good, for repeated or serious cases.

This is based on the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1.
